listing.name: Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere — USA / Ace Combat 3 USA Recomp
listing.summary: Fly combat missions in Ace Combat 3 using your own matching USA PlayStation disc.

steps.title: Download and unpack the setup kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder. On Linux, follow the kit’s requirements for CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler. Use Linux tools for the Linux build.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: For upstream setup use your own USA SLUS-00972 disc in the upstream kit’s supported image format. For CUE/BIN, keep the complete CUE and every referenced track. Use the kit’s bundled OpenBIOS. Keep the complete original separately from generated files.

steps.title: Prepare an independent Mac copy
steps.instruction: Choose the Intel or Apple Silicon setup ZIP for your Mac. Follow the upstream toolchain instructions for Python 3, CMake, Ninja and the selected Apple Clang and SDK. Finish the Generate & rebuild wizard outside Portcove with your own USA SLUS-00972 disc and the kit’s bundled OpenBIOS. Keep the completed build-release/Ace_Combat_3__Electrosphere__USA__Recompiled with its matching config and data. Mac runtime replacement remains upstream-owned.

steps.title: Build the game and add it to Portcove
steps.instruction: Open the project’s launcher and follow its build instructions. Keep the completed game with its required program and compiler files. In Portcove, select the completed program or supported launcher and its start folder. Save the details, then choose Play.

references.instruction: Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions. Use the project’s tools for updates and back up your original files, saves and settings yourself.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching one-track USA CHD (SLUS-00972). Portcove checks the track count and the first data-track SHA-1, then prepares the private runtime with the kit’s bundled OpenBIOS. Play starts the generated player. Keep your original files separately. Native gameplay and save compatibility remain unverified.
